name: Modern CLI Coreutils (Rust & Go Ergonomics)
shortDesc: Blazingly fast replacements for cat, ls, grep, find, cd, and du.
detailedDesc: Essential CLI upgrade: replaces 1970s Unix coreutils with high-speed, syntax-highlighted modern alternatives.

phase.title: Developer Toolchains & CLI Ergonomics
phase.description: Modern Rust/Go coreutils replacements, Git interfaces, Docker container managers, and polyglot runtime toolchains.

packages.name: bat (Syntax-highlighted cat) (Recommended)
packages.description: Cat clone with syntax highlighting for hundreds of languages, Git modifications, and automatic paging.

packages.name: eza (Modern ls with Git status) (Recommended)
packages.description: Modern replacement for ls with file icons, recursive tree views, and live Git repository status indicators.

packages.name: ripgrep (Fast recursive grep) (Recommended)
packages.description: Ultra-fast line-oriented search tool that respects .gitignore rules by default.

packages.name: fd (Fast user-friendly find) (Recommended)
packages.description: Simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find with colorized terminal output.

packages.name: zoxide (Smarter cd command) (Recommended)
packages.description: Smarter cd command that remembers your most frequently accessed directories and jumps instantly with frecency scoring.
pros: Jump to nested paths in 2 keystrokes (`z myproj`)
cons: Requires adding 1 eval line to shell rc

packages.name: fzf (General purpose fuzzy finder) (Recommended)
packages.description: Interactive command-line fuzzy finder for history, file paths, and shell completions.

packages.name: jq (JSON query processor) (Recommended)
packages.description: Command-line JSON processor and filter engine.
pros: Standard tool for shell scripting with API payloads

packages.name: dust (Graphical disk usage du)
packages.description: Visual du clone that renders bar graphs showing where your disk storage is going.
pros: Instant visual intuition for disk hogs
